cards.name: Investor Backchannel
cards.effect: Draw 2 cards. Immediately discard down to 7 if needed. Discard this card.

cards.name: Poach
cards.effect: Take 1 positive-value banked card from a rival's startup into yours. Startup identity cards and active effect cards cannot be taken. Discard this.
cards.flavor: Nice startup. Can we borrow something?

cards.name: Offer They Can't Refuse
cards.effect: React when Golden Handcuffs blocks your Poach: ignore that defense and finish the Poach. No more reactions. Cannot counter a defense against Ditch. Discard this.

cards.name: Patent Lawsuit
cards.effect: Place beside a rival's startup. They skip their next entire turn, including the draw, then discard this. Only 1 pending Lawsuit per player.
cards.flavor: See you in court. Bring snacks.

cards.name: Steal Customer
cards.effect: Take 1 Contract from a rival's startup into yours. Discard this card.

cards.name: Founder Scandal
cards.effect: Privately look at every card in 1 rival's hand. Choose 1 to steal into your hand. Only you see the hand. Discard this card.
cards.flavor: Your pitch deck leaked. So did the group chat.

cards.name: PR Crisis
cards.effect: Place beside a rival's startup as a -$75M valuation penalty. It stays until removed by Crisis PR Team.

cards.name: Cease & Desist
cards.effect: Return 1 Growth card from a rival's startup to their hand. They immediately discard down to 7 if needed. Best Lawyers in Town can block this. Discard this.
cards.flavor: Our lawyers would like a word.

cards.name: Golden Handcuffs
cards.effect: React to Poach: cancel it. React to Ditch against you: cancel it, end the alliance, and take 1 banked card from the attacker, if any. Discard this.

cards.name: Best Lawyers in Town
cards.effect: React: cancel Patent Lawsuit, Steal Customer or Cease & Desist. Or use 1 card play to remove 1 pending Lawsuit from you or your partner. Discard this.
cards.flavor: Our hourly rate is a power move.

cards.name: Raise Salary
cards.effect: React: cancel Poach targeting an Employee belonging to you or your partner. Cannot block Ditch. Discard this.

cards.name: Not For Sale
cards.effect: React: cancel an Investor targeting you or your partner. No card changes hands and no valuation is added. Discard this and the Investor.

cards.name: Crisis PR Team
cards.effect: React: cancel Founder Scandal or PR Crisis. Or use 1 card play to remove 1 active PR Crisis from you or your partner. Discard this.

outcome.headline: STOP THE CRISIS
outcome.caption: BLOCK SCANDAL / CANCEL OR CLEAR PR CRISIS

cards.name: Non-Compete
cards.effect: Attach to 1 of your Employees. Automatically cancel the next Poach targeting it, then discard this. Does not stop Ditch.
cards.flavor: Please read the extremely fine print.

cards.name: Investor
cards.effect: Give a rival this card face-up for +$50M valuation. Take 1 random card from their hidden hand. They must have a card to exchange. The Investor stays in their startup.
cards.flavor: I believed in you. Five minutes ago.

cards.name: Strategic Alliance
cards.effect: Choose a willing, unpartnered rival. Keep this between you; no shared valuation. Either ally may spend 1 card play on an agreed 1-for-1 hand trade. You may defend each other. Only 1 partner each.

outcome.headline: ALLY UP & TRADE
outcome.caption: ONE HAND CARD EACH / BOTH AGREE

cards.name: Ditch
cards.effect: Take 1 banked card from your partner's startup into yours. End the alliance. Golden Handcuffs reverses the theft: they take 1 of your banked cards instead. Discard this.

outcome.headline: DITCH & STEAL 1
outcome.caption: TAKE 1 BANKED CARD / END THE ALLIANCE

cards.name: The Unicorn
cards.effect: At the end of your own completed turn, reach $1,000M valuation after reactions to win. Only one player wins, even if partnered.

cards.name: Your Turn
cards.effect: Draw 1. Discard immediately if over 7. Play up to 2 cards: use an effect or bank its valuation. Recalculate. Reach $1,000M at your turn's end to win.

cards.name: Bank or Play
cards.effect: Bank: place face-up for printed valuation. Its effect is unavailable. Play: use the effect; add no bank value. Reactions come from your hand and use no card plays.

cards.name: Partnerships
cards.effect: Strategic Alliance: both agree; keep separate scores. Spend 1 card play on an agreed 1-for-1 hand trade. Ditch: steal 1 banked card and end the alliance. Golden Handcuffs reverses the theft.
